component: Extension query normalization and API naming

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: messages.query accepts one accountId/folderId or an array under the same public criterion name. Current code normalizes with Array.isArray, preserves the requested search order, and uses account criteria to filter explicitly requested folders. Arrays do not justify renaming these established keys to accountIds/folderIds. The schema states that accounts and folders are searched in the specified order. Review clarity work for this block was deferred from 371 to 375 to avoid rebasing the dependent patch; it was not rejected as a bad idea.
title: Normalize scalar-or-array query criteria without renaming the public keys
